name: Ivan Kovačić
bio:
Ivan's journey into motorsport catering was somewhat accidental. After culinary school in Zagreb, he initially worked in fine dining restaurants, but a chance encounter with a racing team during a corporate event sparked his interest. He was captivated by the energy and precision of the paddock, and offered his services to a smaller racing outfit. He quickly proved his worth, mastering the logistical challenges of providing high-quality meals in ever-changing environments.

Now at Arrow McLaren, Ivan brings a meticulous approach to his role. He's not just preparing food; he's fueling a team. He meticulously plans menus to meet the specific dietary needs of drivers and crew, considering factors like performance, stress levels, and even the local climate. His dedication to quality and his ability to adapt to unexpected situations make him an invaluable part of the team. He is known for sourcing local ingredients whenever possible, adding a unique flair to his offerings.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ivan is of average height, with a sturdy build that reflects his demanding work schedule.

quirks: Insists on using only Croatian sea salt in all dishes.
Secretly taste-tests every dish while humming a traditional Croatian folk song.
Always carries a small notebook filled with menu ideas scribbled in Croatian.
